name: Cash / Currency
description: Guidelines for traveling with cash / currency in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Cash is allowed in both bag types. However, putting cash in checked baggage is strongly discouraged due to security risks. Carry-on is recommended.
conditions: There is no limit on the amount of cash you can carry domestically, but amounts of $10,000 USD or more must be declared when exiting or entering the US internationally.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring cash / currency on a plane?

travelTips: There is no limit on the amount of cash you can carry domestically, but amounts of $10,000 USD or more must be declared when exiting or entering the US internationally.

faq.question: Is cash / currency allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Cash / Currency is allowed in carry-on luggage. Cash is allowed in both bag types. However, putting cash in checked baggage is strongly discouraged due to security risks. Carry-on is recommended.

faq.question: Can you pack cash / currency in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Cash / Currency is allowed in checked bags.
